info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Investment Portfolio Adjustment API
info.description: The Investment Portfolio Adjustment API allows users to fine-tune their investment portfolios by modifying specific parameters associated with their investments. This API is primarily used by financial advisors and portfolio managers to respond to changing market conditions or client preferences. Users can update allocation strategies, risk levels, and other key metrics to ensure optimal performance. By facilitating real-time adjustments, the API enhances portfolio management effectiveness and client satisfaction.

patch.description: This endpoint allows users to update the details of a specific investment portfolio planning resource identified by the given resource ID. It supports partial updates to enable flexibility in managing investment plans.

requestBody.description: Update the investment portfolio planning details for the specified resource. This request allows you to modify various aspects of the investment portfolio including adjustments to the asset allocation, risk profile, and other related attributes.
